It wouldn't be democratic. It would be a limited republic. We elect local representatives, somewhat like we have now. Key differences would be as follows:

All bills proposed have to pass a constitutional test prior to being enacted into law, not afterwards after years of legal challenges.

The president would have the power to use line-item veto to wrangle some control over riders focused on special interest groups.

Taxes would be levied against consumption up to a certain amount, and then a percentage would be levied against capital gains.

The federal government would have zero say in criminal legislation except in cases where national security is concerned. This means no federal funding or supplying of surplus equipment for local LEO's.

Welfare concerns would Also be left to the states. This includes single payer healthcare or privatized insurance if those states choose. The only time the federal government would step in would be to ensure portability across state lines when necessary.
